title: DMS orchestration run request
description: Input of the migrate state machine (and of post for operation=post). Only project and taskKey are required; other values fall back to the task defaults registered in SSM, then to the defaults below.

runId.description: operation=post: the run whose post phase is repeated

operation.description: migrate: pre-flight, start DMS, end (post starts on the DMS event); resume: continue a task stopped at a checkpoint; plan: inspect and pre-flight only, report what would happen; post: repeat the post phase of runId (with fromJob: skip jobs already ok)

completion.description: The first iteration is a full load; CDC and cutover belong to the database team

failOnValidationErrors.description: DMS validation gates the run: a table not validated, with failed validation records or full-load error rows fails DmsValidationErrors; false succeeds as COMPLETED_WITH_VALIDATION_ERRORS. A table without a primary key (DMS cannot validate it) never fails the run; the report lists it in validationSkippedTables. Default: the task's fail_on_validation_errors (true)

allowReset.description: Pre-flight may turn a manual verdict into reset (truncate the scope, reload-target). Without it a dirty target stops the run as MANUAL

maxIterations.description: prepare → pre-jobs → check again, at most this many times (default 3), then manual

exactCountMaxRows.description: count(*) only for tables up to this estimate (default 1000000); larger ones use reltuples

verifyRuntime.description: Where the target check runs: lambda (Data API), fargate (psql, verify-target in the sql-runner image), auto (default: fargate for a big last baseline or a target without Data API, when the image exists)

fargateAboveTables.description: auto: Fargate when the last baseline had more tables in scope (default 500)

fargateAboveBytes.description: auto: Fargate when the last baseline's database was larger (default 53687091200, 50 GiB)

allowNoFingerprint.description: A fresh task without a target fingerprint (no target check) is ready instead of manual (NoFingerprint); it is never reset

method.description: pg-dump: pg_dump -Fc of the scope streamed to dumps/ in S3; snapshot: Aurora cluster snapshot (task with snapshot_dumps), restored by the database team as a new cluster

snapshotAboveBytes.description: The report advises dump.method=snapshot when the target database (pg_database_size) is larger (default 107374182400, 100 GiB)

attempt.description: Set by post when it chains an auto-resume; operators leave it out

parentRunId.description: Set by post when it chains an auto-resume: the run that failed

parentStartedAt.description: Set by post when it chains an auto-resume: when the failed run called StartReplicationTask (tells a task DMS restarted itself from a foreign run)

fromJob.description: operation=post: start at this post job, skipping the ones already ok
